description: Fixed kernel semantics for independently extracted official inet renderer statements. Dynamic operands are replaced only after exact typed interval equivalence. This catalogue does not prove source, population or producer ownership.

arguments: "\tset syswarden_whitelist { type ipv4_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_whitelist6 { type ipv6_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_zt_allowed { type ipv4_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_zt_allowed6 { type ipv6_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_blacklist { type ipv4_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_blacklist6 { type ipv6_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tchain stateful_protect {\n\t\ttype filter hook input priority -10; policy drop;\n"
"\t\ttcp flags & (fin|syn|rst|ack) != syn ct state new counter drop\n"
"\t\tct state new limit rate 2/second burst 5 packets log prefix \"[SYSWARDEN-BLOCK] [CATCH-ALL] \"\n"
"\tchain data_leak_protect {\n\t\ttype filter hook output priority 0; policy accept;\n"
"\t\tudp dport 53 udp length > 512 counter log prefix \"[SYSWARDEN-DNS-EXFIL] \" drop\n"
"\tchain docker_protect {\n\t\ttype filter hook forward priority -10; policy accept;\n"
"\t\tct state new tcp dport { %s } limit rate 5/second burst 10 packets log prefix \"[SYSWARDEN-HONEYPORT] \"\n"
"\t\tct state new tcp dport { %s } counter drop\n"
"\t\tip saddr != @syswarden_zt_allowed limit rate 2/second burst 5 packets log prefix \"[SYSWARDEN-ZERO-TRUST] \"\n"
"\t\tip6 saddr != @syswarden_zt_allowed6 limit rate 2/second burst 5 packets log prefix \"[SYSWARDEN-ZERO-TRUST] \"\n"
"\tset syswarden_asn { type ipv4_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_asn6 { type ipv6_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_geoip { type ipv4_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_geoip6 { type ipv6_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_whitelist_ports { type ipv4_addr . inet_service; flags interval; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_whitelist_ports6 { type ipv6_addr . inet_service; flags interval; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_ssh_bypass { type ipv4_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
"\tset syswarden_ssh_bypass6 { type ipv6_addr; flags interval; auto-merge; }\n"
